summary: N5 layout shift: a best-fit heap allocator whose functions never change. v2 inserts one new function at the top of the file, so every other function moves; four same-sized helpers land exactly on each other's old addresses. v3 emits all definitions in the reverse order. No existing function changes in any step.

pairs.intent: One new function is inserted at the very top of the file and nothing else changes, so every other function moves down by the new function's size (0x30 bytes under clang -O2). The four query helpers at the top have equal size: each now occupies the address its neighbour had, so pairing by address or position is wrong for all of them, and the new function resembles hp_find_first_fit.
